  • Method Details

    • setText

      public boolean setText(int index, String text)
      The regular expressions that Text supports special formats are: <<#\d+#\d+#{0,1}[^#]*#{0,1}[^#]*>> The first # is followed by the minimum number of digits in the page number. If the number of page digits is not enough, 0 is added in front. The second # is followed by the starting value of the page number. The third # is followed by the Bates prefix The fourth # is followed by the Bates suffix eg: When text is set to "front<<#3#1#ab#cd>>back" and the value of pageOffset is 0, the text displayed on the first page is "frontab001cdback".
